name: q_k_down
prompt:
One figure, full body from the top of the head to the feet, nothing cropped, plain white background, no scenery, no text, no frame, no shadow on the floor.
Both hands, wrists, elbows and shoulders clearly readable; fingers distinct where the prompt says where they are.

Portrait image, the same 948:1659 framing as image 2.

Image 1 shows the character design and art style; image 2 shows the exact framing. Draw the SAME woman in the SAME flat vector illustration style (no outlines, no texture, same colours: coral sleeveless dress, dark brown hair in a low bun, dark brown flat shoes), at the SAME size and position in the frame as image 2, in the SAME THREE-QUARTER view as image 2: turned toward us, her body and face toward the RIGHT of the picture, the round bump sticking out to the RIGHT in her outline, the bun on the LEFT of the picture. Plain white background, full body head to feet. Her feet, legs, dress and body stay exactly where they are in image 2 unless the pose says otherwise.
Pose: The arm on the LEFT of the picture is raised and its hand rests gently on the LOWER FRONT of her bump, on the side of the bump nearest us, just above where the bump meets the skirt: the palm lies on the bump, the fingers together and relaxed, following the bump's curve and pointing toward the RIGHT of the picture and slightly down; the BACK of the hand faces us and the thumb lies along the top edge of the hand, separate from the fingers. That elbow is bent and close to her side. The arm on the RIGHT of the picture hangs relaxed beside the far side of the bump, its hand below the bump, exactly as in image 2. Shoulders relaxed and low. She looks DOWN at her bump: her head tilts forward and down, her chin lowered toward her chest, her eyes looking down at her hand on the bump. A tender, closed-mouth smile.
